capex_definition.text: Net capital spending = property, plant and equipment additions + intangible asset additions - proceeds on disposition of property, plant and equipment (FY2018-FY2024 10-K footnotes; same build in FY2015 OFCF table). CAPEX intensity = net capital spending / revenue (2015-2017); 'Agency proceeds CAPEX rate' = net capital spending / agency proceeds (FY2018).
capex_definition.note: 2022 negative = net proceeds (Bolton sale 165.5). FY2025 10-K and Q2-26 10-Q no longer define net capital spending.

fcf_definition.text: Operating Free Cash Flow (OFCF) = cash provided by operating activities - net capital spending (non-GAAP; element of incentive comp). Published in 10-K MD&A FY2015-FY2023; not presented in FY2024/FY2025 10-K or the Q2-26 10-Q/earnings release (EX-99.1 checked: no FCF figure).

notes: Units: USD millions (thousand-dollar filings FY2015-FY2022 divided by 1,000, 3 decimals). Shares in millions. Source rule: BS for year Y from the FY(Y+1) 10-K (FY2025 10-K for 2025); CF for year Y from FY(Y+2) 10-K (FY2025 10-K for 2023-2025); 1H/26 from Q2-26 10-Q (unaudited).

Validation: all BS periods tie (components = total_ca/total_assets/total_cl/total_liab/equity/total_le; tolerance 0.05 for $m rounding). All CF periods tie (op/inv/fin components = subtotals; cfo+cfi+cff+fx = chg_cash; begin+chg = end) and CF cash_end ties to BS cash + restricted cash (+ non-current restricted cash 2016/2021).
